description: This file defines API routes for managing merchants in an e-commerce backend, including adding, searching, fetching, activating/deactivating, approving/rejecting, signing up, and deleting merchants. It interacts with database models and external services like Mailgun.

methods.name: add
methods.description: API endpoint to add a new merchant, validates input, checks for existing email, saves merchant, and sends confirmation email.

methods.name: search
methods.description: API endpoint to search merchants by various fields using a case-insensitive regex, accessible only by admin role.

methods.name: fetch all merchants
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve paginated list of all merchants, accessible only by admin role.

methods.name: disable merchant account
methods.description: API endpoint to activate or deactivate a merchant account, optionally deactivates associated brand and sends email notification.

methods.name: approve merchant
methods.description: API endpoint to approve a merchant, update status, activate account, and create associated merchant user.

methods.name: reject merchant
methods.description: API endpoint to reject a merchant, updating its status.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: API endpoint for merchant signup via token, updates user info, creates merchant brand, and handles password hashing.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a merchant and deactivate associated brand, only accessible by admin role.
